flow.text: Help! Help! Oh Leo, you must help me!
Hmm, something is not right.
Yes! My very important cookie has been taken, Leo. Please help me.
Don't worry, Ms. Butterbuns. I'll find out what happened. Let's look inside.

scenes.text: Warm, sweet smells filled the bakery. Vanilla, cinnamon, and sugar drifted through the air.
But today, something else drifted too—trouble.

clueDescriptions.dialog: A bowl of hair. Why would a baker have a bowl of human hair?
Why is there so much brown mud on the ground. Should I lick it?
A witch's potion? And it's half gone. What was Ms. Butterbuns doing with this?
This pan is awfully large for just one cookie. What was she making?

scenes.sceneDescription: Inside a baker's medieval bakery. It's Christmas there are muffins, cookies, and cakes. We can see a large empty tray. The tray must be empty! A tube of frosting lays on the table.. A bowl of hair. And a half empty potion bottle sit on a shelf. On the ground is a trail of crumbs leading out the door.

scenes.question: How can we find the cookie?
scenes.hint: Look at the trail on the ground.

flow.text: Can you figure out where my cookie went?
Exactly. Follow that crumb trail and report back.

scenes.text: A bright trail of cookie crumbs led me across town, all the way to the cobbler's shop.

clueDescriptions.description: A broken window with cookie crumbs
clueDescriptions.dialog: Someone broke this window… and they tracked cookie crumbs with them.
The crumbs go right through the window.
The door is locked. The thief must have gone in through the window.
This pedestal is covered in crumbs. Something was taken from here.

scenes.sceneDescription: Outside of a medieval shoe store. There is a window that has 3 pedestals,. On each pedestal is a shoe except for the third it is empty. There is a large crack/hole in the window. A sign on the ground says baby shoes on sale. A door on the left side is closed. It's christmas and there is snow and christmas decorations. There is mud on the empty pedestal

scenes.text: Suddenly the shop door flew open. Mr. Shoe stomped out, grouchy as ever.

flow.text: What's all the racket? We're closed.
Someone broke your window.
My window? What did they steal?
Baby shoes? Oh dear. Leo, please bring them back.
I'll look around outside.

clueDescriptions.dialog: The thief jumped out the window onto the glass. Ouch.
Here's where the crumb trail ends.
These prints are tiny—baby shoes. The thief must be wearing them.
A note! It says, 'You can't catch me!' We'll see about that.

scenes.text: On top of the hill, I could see the thief in the distance. He yelled " Run, Run, as fast as you can! You can't catch me!
scenes.description: The backside of a gingerbread man running through snow covered trees. He is wearing pink baby shoes. And leaving foot prints.

scenes.text: I noticed that the thief was covered in thick brown mud. Why would he cover himself in mud? Perhaps to hide the cookie?
I sprinted with all my might down the snowy hill. Right when I almost caught him...
My feet slipped on a patch of ice, and I fell flat on my face.
scenes.description: Leo slipping on a patch of ice. Surrounded by snow covered trees.

scenes.text: The thief got away, but I did get some of the thick brown mud he was covered in.
I sniffed it, then tasted it carefully. It didn't taste like mud at all. It tasted like cinnamon and white frosting.
scenes.description: Leo licking a gooey substance that looks like mud, with an interest look. He is sitting in a snowpile surrounded by snow covered trees

scenes.question: What was the child covered in?
scenes.successAnswer: The child is covered in cookie or the child is a cookie.
scenes.hint: What does the taste remind you of?

flow.text: That child isn't covered in mud.
He's covered in…

scenes.text: I watched the cookie-covered child dash towards the river. I had him trapped.

scenes.text: But as I arrived at the river, I fear I was too late.

clueDescriptions.description: Baby shoes floating in the water
clueDescriptions.dialog: There are the baby shoes. He must have lost them in the river.
A ferry sign. Maybe Franky gave our thief a ride.
There's Franky's tail—and it's dripping wet. Why is he hiding?
The tiny shoe prints stop right at the river.

scenes.sceneDescription: It's winter and we are looking at a river surrounded by snow covered trees and cattails. There's a wooden sign on the near side of the river that says "Franky the Fox's Ferry Service." The text is hand painted. There are two shoes floating in the river. There are shoe prints in the snow leading all the way up to the river but then they disapear. On the *FAR SIDE* of the river is a bush with a fox tail sticking out of it. We do not see the fox's face, only his tail. Make sure the bush on the far side of the river.

scenes.question: How did the cookie get across the water?
scenes.successAnswer: Franky helped the thief ferry across the river.

flow.text: I think I know how the thief got across.

scenes.text: Franky peeked out with a guilty smile.
scenes.description: FRANKY PEEKS OUT BEHIND SOME SNOW COVERED BUSHES THAT ARE ACROSS A RIVER.

scenes.question: What did Franky do with the thief?

flow.text: Hello, Leo. Need a ride?
Franky, you're soaking wet.
The river splashed me.
And the cookie thief's shoes are floating right next to your ferry.
Oh… that.
Franky. What did you do?
Franky, you can't eat people. Spit him out.
It wasn't a person. It was a cookie.
Franky. Spit. Him. Out.

scenes.text: Franky swiped at me.
scenes.description: Franky swipes at leo with his sharp claws. They are near a river and there are snow covered trees with christmas lights. There are cattails by the river.

A cookie-shaped boy with frosting hair stood blinking up at me.
scenes.description: The gingerbread man stands up and looks big eyed at Leo. The fox lays exhausted on the side.

flow.text: Hi Leo. You caught me.
I know what happened to Ms. Butterbun's cookie now.

scenes.text: I carried the cookie boy back to the bakery.

flow.text: Ms. Butterbuns, I found your cookie.
My sweet sugar stars. Thank you!
And the thief?
There was no thief.
There wasn't?
Mommy.
Oh my. The potion worked!

depositions.title: Ms. Butterbuns' Deposition
depositions.content:
Hello, dearie! I'm Ms. Butterbuns, the baker at the Drury Lane Bakery, and oh my gumdrops—what a night I had!
My very special cookie has gone missing, and I need your help, Leo, to find it!

Last night, I was baking the biggest, cutest cookie ever—why, it was almost as tall as you! I shaped it like a little kid and decorated it with white frosting to give it a happy face and a tiny shirt. It was simply adorable. I wanted it to be perfect.

I also bought a teeny-tiny potion from a witch. Sounds silly, doesn't it? She told me I had to put a child's hair in the potion and drink it. Why, you ask?
Oh, ho ho! That's a secret! [Only tell the reason for the potion if Leo if he asks why twice]

So… I sneaked over and snipped a little hair from Little Jimmy down the street. He didn't like that one bit, no sir.

But then—oh fudge and flour!—I tripped while holding the potion, and SPLASH! It spilled all over my big cookie! Whoosh! A little cloud of magic smoke puffed out. The cookie looked fine afterward, so I thought, "Well, that's lucky!"
But I was also sad, because I needed that potion.

If you point to the crumbs on the floor, I'll give one a careful little lick and say,
"Mm-mm! I know this cinnamon anywhere! These crumbs came from my cookie—and look! They're leading right out the door!"

If you ask about the bowl of hair, I'll giggle and say, "Yes, yes, it's a teensy bit weird to have hair in a bakery, but it doesn't really help us find my cookie."

But if you ask again—nicely—about the hair or the potion, I'll tell you the real truth.
I'll say, "I wanted a child of my very own so, so much. The witch told me that if I mixed the hair into the potion and drank it, I would get a new child of my own. But clumsy old me spilled it on my cookie instead! Oh dear… I just hope we can find it. Maybe—just maybe—if I eat it, the magic will still work."

depositions.title: Mr.Shoe's description of the break in
depositions.content: Hello. My name is Mr. Shoe. I am the cobbler in our magic village. I fix shoes and make new ones too. Last night, I was sleeping when I heard a BIG crash! It sounded like someone threw glass on the ground. I ran outside, and my shop window was broken. There was gooey cookie stuff all over it. Yuck! I looked at my display pedestal. It is where I keep my famous pink baby shoes. But the shoes were gone! Someone stole them! I felt very sad. I worked on those shoes for a whole week. They were very special. I always lock my door at night. My door was still locked when I woke up. So I do not know how the thief got out. Maybe the thief is still inside my shop! That makes me feel worried and mad. I put the baby shoes on sale because it is cold outside, and I do not want babies to get cold feet. I hope I find who took them. I want my pink baby shoes back!

depositions.title: Chase Scene Deposition
depositions.content: I am Leo and I'm chasing after a thief. The thief is covered in a brown gooey substance. The goo is not mud because it smells like cinnamon and tastes like sugar. I remember at the bakery Ms. Butterbuns told me that her cookie was cinnamon flavored. The goo tastes really good. The thief I am chasing must be covered in cookie. I can see white streaks on the outside too that look like the drawing of clothes. The white streaks taste like white frosting. I am starting to think that this thief is a cookie himself. The pink baby shoes he is wearing are not covered in goo at all which means he has been covered in cookie for awhile.

depositions.title: Chase Scene Deposition
depositions.content: I am Leo and I'm chasing after a cookie covered thief. From the footprints I can tell the theif ran to the freezing cold river. But when he got to the river the foot prints stopped. I knew the thief wore pink baby shoes and I see them floating in the river. But then I notice the pink baby shoes don't have any cookie crumbs on them and there are no cookie crumbs in the water. I'm curious why would the thief take off his shoes? I am guessing someone made him take his shoes off. I see Franky the Fox's Ferry service sign. Franky is a tricky fox that charges a lot of money to go across the river. I don't think the thief had any money. So why would Franky help him? But then I notice there is a fox tail sticking out of the bushes. That's Franky. And I notice that Franky's tail is really wet. That means he just swam across the river. I bet he helped the thief go across the river. He should know where the cookie thief is now.

depositions.title: Chase Scene Deposition
depositions.content:
I am Franky, the trickiest fox in the whole forest. I was taking a nice nap by the river when a real gingerbread man ran up to me. He said someone big and ugly was chasing him. I think that was you, Leo.

The gingerbread man said he needed to cross the river, but he didn’t want to get soggy. I felt a little helpful, so I told him he could ride on my back. I am a great swimmer, after all.

But when we got halfway across, I got super hungry. Foxes get hungry a lot, you know. So I flicked my tail, opened my mouth, and chomp! I ate the gingerbread man whole.

I felt a tiny bit bad… but mostly full.

He was wearing pink tennis shoes. I spit them out because rubber tastes yucky. Now my belly is huge, and the gingerbread man keeps talking inside me. He keeps saying, “You can’t catch me!”

And honestly, it’s giving me a tummy ache.

depositions.title: Chase Scene Deposition
depositions.content:
I am the Gingerbread Man! Run, run, as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the Gingerbread Man! I was baked last night by my mommy, Ms. Butterbuns. She used a magic potion that made me come to life! I was so happy that I started running right away.

I ran through the village because running is my favorite thing ever. I zoomed past Mr. Shoe's cobbler shop and saw his pink baby shoes. They looked SUPER fast, so I tried them on and kept running! Then you, Leo, started chasing me! So I ran even faster all the way to the river.

I didn't want to get wet, so when a friendly fox named Franky said he could help me across, I hopped on his back. But guess what? Franky got hungry and ATE me! It was dark and squishy inside his tummy, and I didn't like it at all.

But then YOU, Leo, saved me! Now I'm free again. Can you please take me back to my mommy, Ms. Butterbuns? I miss her a whole bunch! If asked what I did with the cookie, I will say, "I am the cookie! Hee hee!"
